milestone: Bounded idempotent recovery RPC retry and learner finish acknowledgement recovery
limits: A recovery RPC may make at most two attempts, each using the configured absolute deadline
Voting RPCs, quorum probes, heartbeats and status do not automatically retry
Rejected requests and invalid authenticated responses are not retried
Learner materialization completion is cached only for the current server lifetime; restart must reapply
Broader full-suite, stress and independent-host production qualification remain incomplete
